description: This is a Java source file defining the 'AuthService' class, which handles user authentication logic such as signup and login within the notes backend application.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: Service class responsible for handling user registration and login operations in a simple notes application backend.

methods.name: signup
methods.description: Registers a new user after verifying the username is not already taken, encodes the password, and saves the user to the repository.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a user by verifying username existence and password matching; currently lacks token provisioning for session management.
